scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,client -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=api" "npm run dev --workspace=web" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=client
